worker_comparison.interpretation: 本次两执行任务 12 请求通过 11 项，三执行任务修复后 12 请求通过 12 项。已受理任务总时长均值从 40.088 秒变为 31.506 秒，批次墙钟时间从 194.74 秒变为 157.503 秒。样本为固定顺序的小规模合成任务，两批代码包含正则与异常处置差异、环境冷启动状态不同，也未随机化，观测改善不能单独归因于 worker 数量。三执行任务配置的验证范围限本机、本次模型服务和任务规模。

observed_concurrency.method: First observed running status plus query_clock until client verification finished_clock. Created_at is never treated as execution start.
observed_concurrency.limitation: Polling can miss short states. End includes SSE delivery, downloads and native terminal confirmation. This is client activity overlap, not a native execution or worker count.
